fix_tasks.title: Add authentication middleware to all data API routes
fix_tasks.description: POST /api/positions, GET /api/vehicles, and GET /api/positions/stream must require a valid session. Use existing requireAdmin() helper from src/lib/auth.ts. Position ingestion endpoint should accept either admin session or a configurable API key for the simulator.

fix_tasks.title: Whitelist columns in login route query
fix_tasks.description: Replace select("*") with explicit column selection: select("id, email, name, role, password_hash"). This limits exposure to only the columns needed for authentication.

fix_tasks.title: Add rate limiting to API endpoints
fix_tasks.description: Add basic rate limiting to position ingestion (100 requests/minute per IP), login (5 attempts/minute per IP). Can use a simple in-memory rate limiter for V1 single-process deployment.

fix_tasks.title: Optimize dashboard positions query
fix_tasks.description: Replace the fetch-all-positions approach with a DISTINCT ON query or maintain a latest_position column on the Vehicle model. Current approach will not scale beyond a few thousand position records.
